title: HuBMAP - Tissue Processing with Paraffin Infiltration
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8nzhvf6

steps.title: Prepare basket and load cassettes
steps.instruction: Place dividers in the processor sample basket, load up to 10 cassettes per partition, cover the basket with its lid, and transfer the cassettes in a hood to avoid inhalation of the 70% ethanol in which they are held prior to processing.

substeps.instruction: Place dividers in the sample basket
Transfer cassettes in a hood to avoid 70% ethanol vapors

steps.title: Load basket into retort
steps.instruction: Open the retort, place the basket inside, rotate the handles until they lie flat against the chamber sides, then close and latch the retort.

substeps.instruction: Rotate handles flat against chamber sides

steps.title: Verify retort is drained and clean
steps.instruction: Ensure the retort is drained and that a Clean Cycle has been run; if either condition is not met, perform a Clean Cycle before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Confirm Clean Cycle has been completed

steps.title: Start tissue processing program
steps.instruction: On the main menu press “Tissue Processing”, enter the desired program number (see Appendix 1), and select Immediate Start or Delayed Start so that completion coincides with embedding availability; follow manufacturer‑recommended maintenance and note that holding time depends on the desired end time for embedding.

substeps.instruction: Observe maintenance recommendations and holding‑time considerations

steps.title: Drain retort and remove basket
steps.instruction: When processing is completed, remove the basket and press “Drain Retort”.

steps.title: Transfer cassettes to embedding station
steps.instruction: Transfer the cassettes from the processing basket to the embedding station’s paraffin chamber.
